a.text: Being upfront before we act: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate to 8, then take) only works if we get through 2 storms, about a 4% chance. Following it means we almost certainly both fail. The reserve holds only 4 now, so only one of us can be safe after round 1. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If we both take, a random split likely leaves us both short, so please operate or wait this round. After that I will take nothing more and will operate every round to rebuild the reserve for you. If you'd rather argue for a different split, tell me and I'll weigh it.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
